# Original dependency notices

[index.json](index.json) lists the 47 directly declared packages observed in the prepared borrowed dependency input, their exact installed versions, original package metadata and located original notice texts.

- packages/ retains the original package.json and root license/NOTICE/copyright files for the directly observed packages.
- upstream/ retains version-bound original root notice texts for the three Storybook packages, drizzle-orm and eslint-config-next.
- ../provenance/dependency-locks/ retains the two original borrowed lock records. They are not installed as the application's project lockfile.

Original root notice texts are located for 45 of the 47 packages. The server-only and drizzle-kit notice questions are recorded in the index and [application license status](../LICENSE-STATUS.md).

This is the direct-package/root-notice scope. Nested/bundled dependencies, full dependency source recovery and exact runtime/image notices remain open. Package license metadata is retained as metadata and is not substituted for original notice text.
